name: windsor-ai-ga4
description:
Bring your own Google Analytics 4 property data into your AI assistant with Windsor.ai, so you can explore website and app performance in plain English.

Reporting examples:
- Analyze Google Analytics 4 (GA4) website and app traffic: users, sessions, engagement rate and conversions/key events.
- Find which channels, source/medium combinations and landing pages bring users and key events.
- Compare traffic and engagement across periods, devices and countries using available dimensions.
- Rank pages by views, average engagement time and bounce rate, by page path or page title.
- List GA4 events by name with event count, events per session and whether each one is a key event.
- Report UTM campaigns: sessions, engaged sessions and key events by campaign, source, medium, term and ad content.
- Compare new and returning users by users and engagement rate.
- See which first-user source, medium and campaign brought new users.
- Split sessions by device category, browser and operating system, or by country, region, city and language.
- See which hours of the day and days of the week bring the most sessions and key events.
- Report e-commerce results: purchase revenue, transactions, add-to-carts and checkouts by day or by channel.
- Rank items by items purchased and item revenue, by item name or category.

Discover connected properties, inspect valid dimensions and metrics, and query traffic, engagement, conversions, and channel performance (sessions, users, engagement rate, conversions, and default channel grouping) over any date range or by day, week, and month.

Common workflows:
- See your top traffic sources and conversions last month
- Compare sessions and engagement across two periods
- Break down conversions by default channel group
- Find the Google Analytics landing pages with the highest session key event rate
- List the pages that lost the most views against the previous month
- Compare organic search, paid search, email and social sessions week by week
- Show GA4 sessions, users and key events month by month for this year
- List the top 20 GA4 events by count
- See whether mobile or desktop visitors engage more

It provides read-only analytics and does not run write actions, cover advertising cost data, or change any property settings.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google Analytics is a trademark of Google LLC.

defaultPrompt: Show my GA4 sessions, users, and conversions by default channel group for the last 30 days.
How have my GA4 sessions and users trended month over month this year?
What's my GA4 engagement rate by default channel group so far this quarter?
capabilities: Analyze Google Analytics 4 (GA4) website and app sessions, users, engagement and conversions
Compare GA4 traffic sources, channels and campaign performance
Analyze GA4 landing pages, devices and countries using available dimensions
Compare Google Analytics 4 performance across days, weeks, months and date ranges
Discover connected GA4 properties and valid reporting dimensions and metrics

positive.prompt: Which Google Analytics 4 properties are connected to Windsor.ai?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists connected GA4 properties so the user can choose which one to analyze.

positive.description: Inspect valid GA4 dimensions and metrics before querying.
positive.prompt: For my GA4 property, show the valid dimensions and metrics for a traffic and conversions report.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns usable dimension and metric IDs and connector options for a GA4 report.

positive.description: Query GA4 traffic and conversions for a recent period.
positive.prompt: Show my GA4 sessions, users, and conversions by default channel group for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns channel-level GA4 data and a concise analysis using valid fields from the Google Analytics 4 connector.

positive.prompt: Which channel drove the most conversions in my GA4 property last month, by default channel group?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns conversions by channel and identifies the single top channel using valid GA4 fields.

positive.description: Help a user connect the GA4 connector.
positive.prompt: I have not connected GA4 yet. Give me the setup link for the Google Analytics 4 connector.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Windsor.ai setup URL for connecting or authorizing the Google Analytics 4 connector.

negative.description: Public benchmark data, not the user's property.
negative.prompt: What is the average bounce rate for e-commerce websites this year?
Write a landing page headline that will improve my conversion rate.

negative.description: General explanation unrelated to connected accounts.
negative.prompt: Explain how attribution models in GA4 differ from Universal Analytics.

review.commerce_description: Windsor.ai does not sell products, show plans, or process payments in the app.
